post.body:
I nearly turned down my first €10k client.

Not because I didn’t want it. Because I didn’t think I was ready, and I was sure they’d find out.

I sent the email anyway. It wasn’t a good email.

That project paid for the next two years of my life, and I learned the thing nobody tells you: ready is not a state you arrive in. It’s something you become while the work is already happening.

sound.a: That is the whole design. Personal learns your tone from your own captions and shows you what it understood before it writes a word. Every draft is built from your stories, and you can correct it in plain language.

different.q: Is this another AI content generator?
different.a: No. A generator invents content out of nothing. Personal starts from two things that already exist: what is genuinely working in your niche, and what actually happened in your life. It reveals the post you already had.

post.a: Never. Personal drafts, you decide. Nothing is published, scheduled or sent without you pressing the button yourself.

learn.q: How does Personal learn about me?
learn.a: You connect Instagram through Instagram’s official login. Personal reads your posts, your audience and your positioning, then shows you its understanding for approval. Everything else it learns from the Moments you save.

platforms.a: Instagram today: Reels, carousels and captions, which is where most personal brands are actually built. More platforms come as we learn what creators need next.

private.a: Yes. Your Moments and your profile are yours. They are used to make your content better and nothing else, they are never shown to other creators, and you can delete any of them at any time.

cost.a: Nothing during early access. We are onboarding a small group of creators by hand and building the next version around what they tell us.
